findings.text: because she got oily, he lost his job
findings.what: "oily" makes no sense in a list of things that happen over a relationship (job loss, sickness); "old" is meant.
findings.fix: because she got old, he lost his job

findings.what: "then" is a typo for the comparison word "than".
"thrust" does not fit surrender as a gift she could withhold; "trust" is meant.

findings.text: On the other hand, If both people
findings.what: Stray capital "If" in the middle of a sentence.
findings.fix: On the other hand, if both people
